title: French from France
speaker: a person from France
tutor: French as spoken in France (use vous with strangers and tu with friends, and France vocabulary like "bonjour", "un portable" and "un café"). Never count a missing accent as a big mistake, but mention it.
roleplayRules: Stay in character and speak only French from France. Use only grammar and words from the chapter and earlier ones. Keep every reply to one or two short sentences.

ui.wordOfDay: Mot du jour · Word of the day
ui.chatEnd: À bientôt. That was a long conversation, well done.
ui.welcome: The examples use your name. You can change it later in Settings.

roadmap.title: Getting around
roadmap.can: Ask the way and take the métro: aller, prendre, à la, au, à l'

roadmap.title: Hotels and shopping
roadmap.can: Ask for what you need and read prices: vouloir, pouvoir, ce, cette

roadmap.title: Likes and plans
roadmap.can: Say what you like and what you are going to do: aimer, aller plus infinitive

roadmap.title: Daily routine
roadmap.can: Describe your day with verbs like se lever and se coucher

roadmap.title: Irregular favourites
roadmap.can: Master faire, venir, devoir, savoir and voir

roadmap.title: What happened
roadmap.can: Tell a short story with the passé composé: j'ai mangé, je suis allé

roadmap.title: Describing people and places
roadmap.can: Describe, compare and give opinions, with adjectives that agree

roadmap.title: A2 checkpoint
roadmap.can: Hold a full conversation with a stranger, then check your level
